intro.title: Recording Digital Inward Prescriptions (Rx)
intro.subtitle: Inbound Rx digitization, patient demographics, verified prescriber linking, and dosage regimen audit

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 3, Part 4: Recording Digital Inward Patient Prescriptions. Digitizing incoming doctor prescriptions guarantees foolproof compliance and instant counter dispensing.
Navigate to Compliance and select Prescriptions. MediFlow's central prescription vault displays all logged patient prescriptions along with doctor credentials and validation status.
Click New Prescription. Enter the patient's full name, contact number, age, and select the certified prescribing practitioner directly from your doctor registry.
Add the prescribed pharmaceutical molecules, specifying precise dosage, administration frequency, and treatment course duration.
Click Save Prescription to commit the record. The prescription is assigned an immutable registry number, ready for fast dispensing. Next, explore Statutory Drug Registers.

outro.takeaway: Digital Rx Repository: Capture patient demographics, certified doctor credentials, and dosage schedules into an immutable compliance vault ready for POS dispensing.
